title: 第9章 接下来我保证不再侵犯你第10章 掌教的道侣有点像女帝祖师
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
不知道过了多久。
林云慢条斯理的穿着衣服。
偶尔瞥一眼蜷缩在一旁的绝美女帝。
她仿佛已经认命了。
又或者已经放弃了抵抗。
一开始还有些抗拒，后面居然有些配合了起来。
仿佛正应了那句话。
既然抵抗不了，那就享受吧。
不过也许她是发现了，自己越是挣扎，这个魔鬼就越是兴奋。
林云从储物戒指之中取出毛毯，抬手一挥。
白色的毛毯就轻飘飘的盖住了女帝那绝美的有着致命诱惑的娇躯。
闭着眼睛的姬曦瑶长长的睫毛微微颤了颤。
她的内心已经一片冰冷。
既然怒和诅咒都没有任何作用。
那么又为什么要浪费力气呢。
她本就冰雪聪明，而且意志强大异于常人。
不然也不可能修为到这样恐怖的境界。
其实林云刚刚在交欢的时候就察觉到了。
她体内被封印的能量一旦彻底释放出来的话。
别说是一百个自己了，怕是一千个都不够她杀的。

这整个世界都要引来一场大灾难。
幸好，她自己封印了自己。
导致现在陷入了某种悖论之中。
没有恢复修为的话，她也没办法解除自己的封印。
但是即使是恢复修为，那也只是弑神匕首封印之前的破虚境界。
至于她是怎么来到下界。
又要怎么飞升回去。
那就不是林云要考虑的问题了。
也许她有自己的方法吧。
他现在要做的事情就是先稳住她的情绪。
只要不是立马杀了他就行。
退一万步来说。
牡丹花下死做鬼也风流。
像女帝这样强大到让自己都要仰望的存在。
求自己放过她。
这样的体验，是任何东西都换不来的。
林云感觉即使是死也值得了。
当然了，能不死自然是最好的。
可惜那个傻逼系统又不知道跑哪去了，也不知道还会不会回来。
就给了自己一个千倍天赋。

和神级双休卡。
天赋这种东西，他不缺，而且活着才有用，还需要大量的资源供应。
至于卡，已经用完了。
content_en:
I don’t know how long it took.
Lin Yun put on his clothes slowly.
Occasionally, I glanced at the beautiful queen huddled aside.
She seemed to have resigned herself to her fate.
Or maybe they have given up resistance.
There was some resistance at first, but later on he became somewhat cooperative.
It seems to be in response to that sentence.
If you can't resist, then enjoy it.
But maybe she discovered that the more she struggled, the more excited the devil became.
Lin Yun took out the blanket from the storage ring and waved it.
The white blanket lightly covered the empress's beautiful and fatally seductive body.
Ji Xiyao's long eyelashes trembled slightly with her eyes closed.
Her heart was already cold.
Since anger and curses have no effect.
So why waste the effort.
She is inherently smart and has a strong will that is different from ordinary people.
Otherwise, it would be impossible to cultivate to such a terrifying state.
In fact, Lin Yun had just noticed it during sex.
Once the sealed energy in her body is completely released.
Not to mention a hundred of herself, I'm afraid even a thousand of them wouldn't be enough for her to kill.
This whole world will lead to a great disaster.
Fortunately, she sealed herself.
As a result, we are now trapped in some kind of paradox.
If she didn't recover her cultivation, she wouldn't be able to lift her seal.
But even if he recovers his cultivation level, it will only be the realm of breaking the void before the God-killing dagger was sealed.
As for how she came to the lower world.
How to ascend back again.
That is not a problem for Lin Yun to consider.
Maybe she has her own way.
What he has to do now is to stabilize her mood first.
As long as you don't kill him immediately.
Let’s take a step back.
It is also romantic to die under the peony flowers and become a ghost.
A being like the Empress who is so powerful that she even looks up to her.
Beg yourself to let her go.
This kind of experience cannot be exchanged for anything.
Lin Yun felt that even death was worth it.
Of course, it would be best to not die.
It's a pity that that stupid system has gone somewhere, and I don't know if it will come back.
I gave myself a thousandfold talent.
God level double rest card.
He has no shortage of talent, and to be useful while alive requires a large supply of resources.
As for the card, it has been used up.
